Title: Project setup: monorepo, TypeScript, lint, tests, CI, staging deploy, error tracking
Acceptance criteria: A push runs CI; staging deploys automatically; a thrown test error appears in the error tracker.

Title: Database foundation: migrations, organisation key on every table, Row-Level Security helpers, isolation test harness
Acceptance criteria: An automated test proves organisation A cannot read or write organisation B rows on every table; CI fails if a new table has no policy.

Title: Signup and verification: create agency or individual-landlord organisation with owner, email/phone verification, password reset
Acceptance criteria: A new user can sign up, verify, reset a password and land in an empty organisation as Owner.

Title: Roles, permissions and scoped access (property and portfolio level)
Acceptance criteria: A Caretaker assigned to one property cannot open another property's records, tested at API level.

Title: Audit log service: append-only events with who, when, before and after
Acceptance criteria: Editing a record writes an audit event; audit rows cannot be edited or deleted through the API.

Title: Session management: device list, remote sign-out, timeout
Acceptance criteria: A user can end another device's session and it is rejected on its next request.

Title: Design system and web shell using the Tenaville palette
Acceptance criteria: Shared layout, navigation, form and table components render on desktop and mobile widths.

Title: Staff invitations: invite by email and role, accept, revoke, resend
Acceptance criteria: An Owner or Admin invites an email address with a role; the invitee receives a link, accepts, and lands in that organisation with that role. Only an Owner can invite an Owner. A pending invitation can be revoked and resent. Every change is audited.

Title: Landlord records with remittance details
Acceptance criteria: A landlord can be created with contact details, preferred channel and bank details visible only to authorised roles.

Title: Properties: create, edit, photos, notes, no public exposure
Acceptance criteria: A property saves with photos; no unauthenticated URL or search index exposes it.

Title: Units and statuses
Acceptance criteria: Units can be added under a property with vacant, occupied, reserved, under maintenance and inactive statuses.

Title: Link property to landlord
Acceptance criteria: A property cannot be saved without one landlord; reassigning is audited.

Title: Management mandate: commission type and rate, remittance schedule, permitted deductions
Acceptance criteria: A mandate saves per landlord or property and is versioned so past statements keep their original terms.

Title: Import framework with templates, validation and row-level errors; apply to properties and units
Acceptance criteria: Uploading a file with 3 bad rows creates nothing until fixed and returns an error list naming each row and field.

Title: Private file storage: signed URLs, image compression, authorisation at download
Acceptance criteria: A file link expires, cannot be guessed, and fails for a user without access to the record.

Title: Tenant records and contacts
Acceptance criteria: A tenant stores contacts and optional next-of-kin and employer details with change history.

Title: Create lease directly: parties, unit, dates, rent, frequency, deposit and other upfront charges
Acceptance criteria: A lease can be created from a tenant and unit without an application; the unit becomes occupied on activation.

Title: Lease states and history preservation
Acceptance criteria: State changes follow allowed transitions; editing a tenant never alters historical lease terms.

Title: Charge and rent schedule generation (annual, half-yearly, quarterly, monthly, irregular)
Acceptance criteria: Activating a lease produces the correct dated charges, including a one-off irregular schedule, with totals matching lease terms.

Title: Renewals that retain history
Acceptance criteria: A renewal creates a linked new lease and keeps the previous terms viewable.

Title: Expiry alert engine (90, 60, 30 days, configurable)
Acceptance criteria: Leases entering each configured window create a task for the responsible agent once only.

Title: Move-in and move-out records: handover notes, meter readings, balance
Acceptance criteria: Move-out records outstanding balance and prompts deposit handling before closing the lease.

Title: Plan entitlements: definitions, limits and feature flags enforced in the API and UI
Acceptance criteria: A request that would exceed a plan limit is refused by the API, not only hidden in the UI. Limits come from the plans table, not from code.

Title: Record payments with method, reference, proof upload; label recorded vs partner-confirmed
Acceptance criteria: A payment saves with its method and proof and displays 'recorded by staff', never 'confirmed'.

Title: Allocation engine: oldest-first, manual override, part payment, overpayment, tenant credit
Acceptance criteria: The sum of allocations always equals the payment; overpayment becomes credit; override requires permission and is audited.

Title: Receipts: sequential numbering per organisation or branch, PDF, shareable link
Acceptance criteria: Two concurrent payments never receive the same number; a voided or reversed receipt keeps its number and is never reused; the issued numbers contain no gaps (PRD §16.2). Numbers come from the allocator in TV-144.

Title: Reversals and corrections without overwriting history
Acceptance criteria: Reversing a payment creates a linked reversing entry with a reason; the original stays visible.

Title: Daily cash-up per user and payment method
Acceptance criteria: A user's cash-up lists all payments recorded that day grouped by method and totals match the ledger.

Title: Gapless receipt number allocator, shared by online and offline issue
Acceptance criteria: Numbers are allocated with no gaps under concurrency and under rollback: a failed payment transaction consumes no number. A Postgres sequence does not satisfy this, being non-transactional. Offline receipts numbered on sync draw from the same allocator. A test asserts the set of issued numbers is contiguous after a run including failures.

Title: Landlord ledger core: append-only entries, client funds separated from agency funds
Acceptance criteria: Every receipt creates ledger entries on the correct side; a test proves client and agency balances never mix.

Title: Commission calculation per mandate, recognised on cash received by default
Acceptance criteria: Commission matches the mandate on partial and full payments; reversing a payment reverses its commission.

Title: Caution deposit lifecycle as client funds
Acceptance criteria: A deposit is held, deducted with evidence or refunded, each step producing a ledger entry.

Title: Remittance recording with balance guard
Acceptance criteria: A remittance above the available balance is blocked unless an authorised role approves an advance, which is recorded as a debit.

Title: Rent roll, upcoming dues and arrears ageing views
Acceptance criteria: Arrears buckets (1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+) reconcile to the sum of overdue charges.

Title: Usage metering: active units, properties, users, storage and messages
Acceptance criteria: Usage is counted at the end of the billing period with a 3-day grace, and warnings appear at 80% and 100% of a band.

Title: Statements: draft, reviewed, issued; immutable; numbered revisions; PDF; access limited to staff and that landlord
Acceptance criteria: An issued statement cannot be edited; a correction produces Revision 2 linked to the original; another landlord cannot open it.

Title: Evidence attachments on ledger entries
Acceptance criteria: Receipts, invoices and approvals attach to the entry they support and show on the statement.

Title: Import tenants, leases and current charges
Acceptance criteria: A valid file creates linked tenants, leases and charges; errors are reported per row.

Title: Opening balances at a cutover date: tenant arrears and credits, landlord balances
Acceptance criteria: Opening entries are labelled and locked after cutover confirmation; totals equal the agency's supplied figures.

Title: Dry-run and rollback for import batches
Acceptance criteria: A dry-run shows what would be created; rolling back a completed batch removes only that batch.

Title: Receipt and statement footer: Tenaville line on Free, agency branding on paid
Acceptance criteria: A free-plan receipt carries the Tenaville line; a paid one carries the agency's own branding.

Title: Non-rent lease charges: service charge, utilities and agreed fees, one-off or recurring
Acceptance criteria: A charge agreed in the tenancy but not rent — service charge, utilities, an agreed fee — is raised against the lease either once or on its own frequency, ages into arrears, appears on the landlord statement and is allocated to like any other charge. Caution deposits stay in lease_deposits; repair recharges stay with TV-050.

Title: Messaging provider abstraction and message log (WhatsApp, SMS, email)
Acceptance criteria: Switching provider is configuration only; each message stores recipient, template, time, status and related record.

Title: Configurable templates with merge fields
Acceptance criteria: Reminder, receipt, expiry and maintenance templates render the correct tenant, unit and amount values.

Title: Consent, opt-outs, channel preferences and rate limits
Acceptance criteria: An opted-out contact receives no marketing message; operational messages follow channel preference.

Title: WhatsApp template approval tracking and fallback channel
Acceptance criteria: A business-initiated message uses only an approved template; a failed WhatsApp send retries by SMS or email.

Title: Tasks with owner, due date, priority, related record
Acceptance criteria: A task links to a lease, tenant or request and shows in the owner's daily list.

Title: Reminder and follow-up rules for upcoming and overdue charges and expiries
Acceptance criteria: Configured reminders send once per rule, stop when paid, and log each send.

Title: WhatsApp click-to-chat sharing for receipts and reminders
Acceptance criteria: A receipt or reminder opens in WhatsApp on the staff member's own phone with no automated send, so the free plan costs nothing to run.

Title: Create maintenance requests with category, urgency, access notes, media
Acceptance criteria: Staff or a tenant can raise a request with photos against a property or unit.

Title: Core statuses and transitions
Acceptance criteria: Only allowed transitions are accepted; each is timestamped.

Title: Assignment, priority, due date, responsible staff
Acceptance criteria: An unassigned request appears in the manager's queue; assignment notifies the assignee.

Title: Timeline, comments and attachments
Acceptance criteria: All changes and messages appear in order on the request.

Title: Vendor directory
Acceptance criteria: A vendor can be created with trade, areas and notes and selected for a job.

Title: Actual cost, invoices, receipts, before/after photos, completion notes
Acceptance criteria: A job cannot be completed without a recorded cost or an explicit 'no cost' flag.

Title: Allocate repair cost to landlord, tenant, agency or other payer with ledger link
Acceptance criteria: A landlord-borne cost appears as a deduction on the next statement; a tenant-borne cost creates a tenant charge.

Title: Repair history persists against the unit after a tenancy ends
Acceptance criteria: A new tenant's unit view still shows earlier repairs.

Title: Administrator-configured maintenance status transitions
Acceptance criteria: An administrator can change which status transitions are allowed, without code changes, and the change is audited. Resolve first whether this is MAINT-3's own clause (P0, here) or part of ORG-7's workflow templates (P1, TV-134) and record the decision.

Title: Document management: attach to records, types, issue and expiry dates, audit
Acceptance criteria: A document attached to a lease shows uploader, type and dates and is hidden from unauthorised users.

Title: Landlord portal (read-only): properties, occupancy, collections, balances, statements
Acceptance criteria: A landlord sees only their own properties and issued statements; no edit actions are available.

Title: Tenant access linked to organisation, tenant and active lease; responsive mobile web
Acceptance criteria: A tenant signs in or uses a secure link and sees only their own lease data on a phone browser.

Title: Tenant view: lease summary, dues, recorded payments, receipts, shared documents
Acceptance criteria: Balances shown match the ledger; only documents explicitly shared appear.

Title: Tenant repair request and status notifications
Acceptance criteria: A tenant submits a request with photos and receives acknowledgement and completion notices.

Title: Trial lifecycle: start, reminders at day 20, 27 and 30, expiry, 7-day grace
Acceptance criteria: A new organisation starts a 30-day Growth trial without a card, is reminded three times, and falls to Free limits after a 7-day grace.

Title: Mobile foundation: Expo app, login, navigation, PIN or biometric lock
Acceptance criteria: The app signs in, locks after inactivity and unlocks with PIN or biometrics.

Title: Mobile: tenants, arrears, record payment and send receipt
Acceptance criteria: A payment recorded on the phone appears on the web app with a receipt sent to the tenant.

Title: Mobile: maintenance logging with photos, tasks and follow-ups
Acceptance criteria: A repair logged on the phone shows photos and assignment on the web app.

Title: Low-data operation: image compression, resumable uploads, pagination
Acceptance criteria: A 5 MB photo uploads under 500 KB and an interrupted upload resumes.

Title: Push notifications for tasks, assignments and alerts
Acceptance criteria: An assigned task triggers a push notification that opens the task.

Title: Downgrade to Free: choose the active property, read-only locking, restore on upgrade
Acceptance criteria: Over-limit data stays visible, printable and exportable but accepts no new records. Upgrading restores it immediately. Nothing is deleted.

Title: Local store and outbox with client-generated IDs
Acceptance criteria: Records created offline persist across app restarts and queue for sync.

Title: Idempotent sync endpoints and conflict rules (server-authoritative for money)
Acceptance criteria: Replaying the same batch five times creates each payment once; last-writer-wins is never applied to financial records.

Title: Provisional receipts and server-assigned official numbers on sync
Acceptance criteria: An offline receipt is marked 'pending sync' and receives its official number only on sync, with the tenant notified.

Title: Sync status per record, visible retry, no silent discard
Acceptance criteria: Failed items show a reason and a retry; none disappear.

Title: Encrypted local storage, remote revoke and local wipe
Acceptance criteria: Revoking a device from the web wipes cached data on its next connection.

Title: Subscription checkout and invoices through a Nigerian payment gateway
Acceptance criteria: A plan is bought in naira through the gateway with a VAT-bearing invoice and a receipt; a failed renewal retries and is reported, not silently lapsed.

Title: Upgrade and downgrade prompts: band warnings and the plan-change flow
Acceptance criteria: Approaching a limit shows what the next band costs before anything changes; a plan change states plainly what is gained or locked.

Title: Core operational reports with CSV and PDF export
Acceptance criteria: Rent roll, occupancy, expiries, arrears, collections and repairs reports reconcile to ledger totals.

Title: Enforce access rules in reports, exports and dashboards
Acceptance criteria: A scoped manager's exports contain only their permitted properties.

Title: Security hardening: dependency scanning, rate limiting, backup and restore drill
Acceptance criteria: A restore from backup to a clean environment succeeds and is timed; critical dependency alerts are zero.

Title: Performance and load testing, monitoring and alerts
Acceptance criteria: Core screens meet the load target in the PRD on a mid-range phone connection.

Title: Hybrid billing: base plan, per-unit overage capped at the next tier, annual plans
Acceptance criteria: A bill is the base price plus per-unit overage, never more than the next tier's price. Annual plans bill in advance at the plan's discount.

Title: Full organisation data export
Acceptance criteria: An administrator can export all organisation data in documented formats at any time, including after a subscription lapses.

Title: Pilot onboarding runbook, sample templates and support routine
Acceptance criteria: A new pilot agency can be loaded using the runbook without developer help beyond import support.

Title: Onboard three pilot agencies and import their data
Acceptance criteria: Opening balances reconcile to each agency's own records at cutover.

Title: Run pilot month-end: statements, remittances, feedback triage
Acceptance criteria: Statements are accepted by pilot agencies and landlords without manual correction; feedback is triaged into the backlog.

Title: App store and Play Store release preparation
Acceptance criteria: Internal test builds distribute to pilot staff; store listings and privacy information are ready.

Title: R1 exit-criteria verification and defect buffer
Acceptance criteria: Every exit criterion in PRD section 16.2 is checked and recorded; no critical isolation or security defects remain open.

Title: Payment partner selection, integration boundary and sandbox
Acceptance criteria: A decision record names the partner and settlement flow; a provider-neutral interface passes sandbox tests.

Title: Virtual accounts per unit or tenant
Acceptance criteria: Each active lease can receive a virtual account number that maps unambiguously to that lease.

Title: Signed, idempotent, replay-protected webhooks
Acceptance criteria: A duplicate or replayed webhook creates no second payment; an invalid signature is rejected and logged.

Title: Settlement-account model in ledger and statements
Acceptance criteria: Settlement into agency client account, landlord account or split is configurable and reflected in the ledger.

Title: Payment links per charge
Acceptance criteria: A tenant can pay a charge through a link and the payment is allocated automatically.

Title: Auto-matching and review queue for unmatched payments
Acceptance criteria: A payment with a known reference matches automatically; the rest appear in a queue with suggested matches.

Title: Tenant view of partner-confirmed payments and payment instructions
Acceptance criteria: Tenants see confirmed versus recorded payments clearly labelled, plus their account details.

Title: Scheduled remittance runs with approval and reconciliation
Acceptance criteria: A run lists landlords due, requires approval, and each remittance reconciles to a bank reference.

Title: Branded PDF statements
Acceptance criteria: A statement can use agency branding and downloads as PDF.

Title: Exports for external accounting tools
Acceptance criteria: An export file imports cleanly into a reference accounting tool with a documented mapping.

Title: Late fee rules where policy and law permit
Acceptance criteria: Late fees apply only when enabled, follow the configured rule and are visible to the tenant.

Title: Lead capture (manual and agency channels) with contact data
Acceptance criteria: A lead can be created from a call, WhatsApp or private enquiry form with consent notice.

Title: Pipeline stages, assignment, source and next action
Acceptance criteria: Each lead has an owner, stage, source and a next action with a due date.

Title: Chronological activity timeline
Acceptance criteria: Calls, messages, tasks and notes appear in order on the lead.

Title: Follow-up reminders and daily queue
Acceptance criteria: An agent sees today's and overdue follow-ups; overdue items alert the manager.

Title: Duplicate detection and merge preserving history
Acceptance criteria: Likely duplicates are flagged; merging keeps all activity.

Title: Lost reasons, nurture dates, reactivation
Acceptance criteria: A lost lead can be reactivated without creating a new record.

Title: CRM messaging templates and marketing consent
Acceptance criteria: Marketing messages are blocked without consent; tenancy messages stay separate.

Title: Appointments: types, links, scheduling, conflict flagging, reschedule
Acceptance criteria: Double-booking a staff member is flagged; an appointment links to a lead, tenant or property.

Title: Confirmations and reminders with delivery status
Acceptance criteria: Attendees receive configured reminders and the delivery status is stored.

Title: Outcomes, automatic follow-up tasks and viewing feedback
Acceptance criteria: Recording 'interested' creates a follow-up task with owner and due date.

Title: Calendar and list views with filters
Acceptance criteria: Staff can filter the agenda by team, type and status.

Title: Shareable unit sheets (private, expiring, non-indexed)
Acceptance criteria: A unit sheet link expires, is excluded from search engines and shows only chosen fields.

Title: Vacancy history
Acceptance criteria: Each vacancy records dates, reason and next action; reports show vacancy duration.

Title: Lead to application to lease conversion without re-entry
Acceptance criteria: Converting an approved lead creates the tenant and lease with prefilled data.

Title: Screening templates and configurable steps with evidence types and deadlines
Acceptance criteria: A template with required and optional steps can be applied to a property and overridden by a landlord.

Title: Applicant form and secure document upload
Acceptance criteria: An applicant completes the form and uploads evidence through the portal.

Title: Status workflow, reviewer assignment, request for more information
Acceptance criteria: Reviewers move an application through statuses and the applicant is notified of required actions.

Title: Consent capture with purpose, timestamp and privacy notice version
Acceptance criteria: No application data is processed without a recorded consent for each purpose.

Title: Review audit trail and restricted access
Acceptance criteria: Only authorised roles see screening data; every review action is logged.

Title: Sensitive identifier handling: masking and verification results only
Acceptance criteria: National or financial identifiers are masked by default and not stored where a pass or fail result suffices.

Title: Block lease activation while required steps are incomplete, with authorised override
Acceptance criteria: An incomplete application cannot activate a lease without a recorded override and reason.

Title: Retention and anonymisation for rejected or withdrawn applications
Acceptance criteria: Data is anonymised or deleted after the configured period and the action is logged.

Title: Fairness controls: prohibited criteria guard and criteria versioning
Acceptance criteria: Templates cannot use prohibited characteristics; each decision records the criteria version.

Title: Screening reports
Acceptance criteria: Reports show volumes and completion times without exposing unnecessary personal data.

Title: Co-tenants and guarantors
Acceptance criteria: A lease can have several tenants and guarantors, each with their own contacts.

Title: Rent review and escalation rules with approval
Acceptance criteria: A configured increase proposes new terms that need approval before applying.

Title: Notices and letters from agency templates
Acceptance criteria: A formal reminder or expiry notice generates from a template and is stored on the lease.

Title: Configurable tax lines (VAT on commission, withholding on rent), off by default
Acceptance criteria: Enabling a tax line changes statements and reports as configured and is audited; default behaviour is unchanged.

Title: Vendor quotations and comparison
Acceptance criteria: Two or more quotes can be attached to a request and compared side by side.

Title: Approval thresholds and landlord approvals with comments in the portal
Acceptance criteria: A job above the threshold cannot proceed until the landlord approves, and the history is kept.

Title: Work orders
Acceptance criteria: A work order records scope, vendor, target date and agreed cost.

Title: Tenant confirm or reopen, and repair tracking for tenants
Acceptance criteria: A tenant can confirm resolution or reopen with a reason; they see status and next step.

Title: Preventive maintenance schedules
Acceptance criteria: A recurring schedule generates requests on time.

Title: Emergency escalation rules and action log
Acceptance criteria: An emergency request notifies named contacts and records every action taken.

Title: Conditional maintenance statuses for quote and approval workflows
Acceptance criteria: With quotation and approval workflows enabled, Triage, Awaiting Quote, Awaiting Landlord Approval and Approved become available and appear in the allowed transitions. With those workflows off, only the eight core statuses are offered.

Title: Inspection checklists on mobile with photos, notes, meter readings, acknowledgement
Acceptance criteria: An inspection completed offline syncs with photos and a signature or acknowledgement.

Title: Document expiry alerts, malware scanning and time-limited links
Acceptance criteria: An expiring document alerts staff; an infected test file is rejected.

Title: Custom fields and property documents
Acceptance criteria: Admins can add fields per property or unit and attach operating documents.

Title: Tenant portal extras: contact updates, secure request channel, renewal prompts, accessibility
Acceptance criteria: A tenant can state renewal intent without auto-renewing; screens meet the accessibility and low-data targets.

Title: Landlord portfolio indicators
Acceptance criteria: A landlord sees agreed indicators for occupancy, arrears and costs.

Title: Branches, teams and branch-level reporting
Acceptance criteria: Reports and access can be limited to a branch.

Title: Analytics foundation: filters, documented metric definitions, configurable occupancy denominator
Acceptance criteria: Every metric shows its formula and time window; occupancy excludes configured unit statuses.

Title: Collections and landlord dashboards
Acceptance criteria: Billed versus collected, arrears ageing and landlord net remittance reconcile to the ledger.

Title: Lease, vacancy and maintenance dashboards
Acceptance criteria: Expiry pipeline, vacancy duration, response and resolution times and repeat issues are shown.

Title: CRM funnel analytics
Acceptance criteria: Response time, appointment attendance and conversion are reported.

Title: Export reports to CSV, XLSX and PDF
Acceptance criteria: Exports respect scope and match on-screen totals.

Title: Organisation settings: approval limits, workflow templates, notification preferences
Acceptance criteria: Admins can change limits and templates without code changes; changes are audited.

Title: Optional two-factor authentication
Acceptance criteria: Users can enable 2FA and admins can require it for specific roles.

Title: Recurring tasks and event-driven task creation
Acceptance criteria: A configured event creates tasks automatically without duplicates.

Title: Inbox for messages needing a human reply
Acceptance criteria: Inbound replies appear in a work queue linked to the contact, within provider limits.

Title: Onboarding checklist and assisted import tooling
Acceptance criteria: A new organisation sees a checklist and can use sample templates for each import.

Title: Supported OS versions and forced-update policy
Acceptance criteria: An outdated app version with a breaking API change is prompted to update.

Title: Validate optional transaction-fee model before building
Acceptance criteria: A written decision confirms legal, pricing and tenant-impact review before any fee is implemented.

Title: R2 security review, performance test and regression pack
Acceptance criteria: No critical findings open; regression suite covers R1 and R2 money, ledger and isolation paths.

Title: R2 pilot rollout and exit-criteria verification
Acceptance criteria: Pilot agencies run payments, CRM and maintenance in production and R2 exit criteria are recorded as met.
